text: As stories of the Slit-Mouthed Woman spread through a Japanese town, an earthquake [shakes a corpse out of a closet|trigger|unsealing what was shut away] in an abandoned house, and a voice is heard asking if she is pretty. Children begin to vanish, among them Mika, who tells her teacher Kyōko that her mother hits her and is then taken by [a masked woman with a slit mouth|images|dolls, masks and likenesses]. Kyōko and her colleague Noboru learn that the spirit can [pass into other women|threat|being taken over], and Noboru recognises her in a thirty-year-old photograph as [his own abusive mother|origin|harm done in childhood].
